search_text: published ZDI-10-055 ZDI-CAN-603 Sun Java Runtime Environment Mutable InetAddress Socket Policy Violation Vulnerability 2010-04-05 CVE-2010-0095 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-0095 10.0 ['Sun Microsystems'] ['Java Runtime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to violate security policies on vulnerable installations of Sun Java Runtime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must run a malicious applet. The specific flaw allows malicious applets to connect to network addresses other than the originating applet and client IPs. A handcrafted applet can override compile time checks to prevent compilation of a mutable InetAddress subclass. This results in the ability to circumvent the Applet SecurityManager restictions. Sun Microsystems has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
